description: Golden question set for the answer-quality evaluation. Every expected fact is taken verbatim or near-verbatim from a file under knowledge-base/India/ — never from outside knowledge. Matching is case-insensitive substring: each entry in expectedFacts is a group of acceptable alternatives, and the group is satisfied if any alternative appears in the answer. forbiddenFacts lists phrases whose presence indicates a fabricated claim no source supports. expectedSources are document titles, matched against citations[].source. Case ids prefixed 'bn-' (Bengali) and 'mixed-' (romanised Bengali / Bengali-English mix) reuse only the phrasing style of real customer messages to a Bangladeshi travel agency; their expected facts still come solely from knowledge-base/India/, with Bengali alternatives (including Bengali digits) because the prompt does not fix the answer language. Figures that agency material states without an official source (e.g. minimum bank balances, 35x45 mm photos) appear only as forbiddenFacts.
